ja: ど　う　ぞ　、　そ　の　ま　ま　か　ぶ　り　つ　い　て　く　だ　さ　い
ガ ブ ッ　！　っ　て
『機動戦士ガンダム 水星の魔女』より、主人公「スレッタ・マーキュリー」の一般制服姿がFigure-rise Standardシリーズにラインアップ！
新規タンポ印刷の表情パーツや多彩な表情デカール、ハンドパーツなどが付属！
●　一般制服で立体化！
アスティカシア高等専門学園に於ける一般制服カラーで立体化！
制服の色分けはパーツ分割で再現。胸元のマークは付属シールで装飾。
髪パーツは、パーツ構成を考慮し立体的な形状で再現。
ブーツ表面のシワやハンドパーツは繊細な指先まで細かく表現！
●　豊富な表情パーツが合計5種付属！
新規タンポ印刷の表情が付属！
その他に新規造形を含めた計４種類の表情再現用パーツが付属し、水転写デカールと併せてスレッタのバラエティー豊かな表情を再現。
別売りの「Figure-rise Standard スレッタ・マーキュリー」（一般店頭販売アイテム）にも各表情パーツは使用可能！
●　豊富な付属品！
耳パーツの開閉を再現できるハロや、スレッタのポージングを支えるディスプレイ用台座も同梱。
劇中で登場したトマトと専用の右手パーツが新規造形で付属！
付属品：　ハロ　／　トマト×１個　／　フェイスパーツ×５種（内タンポ印刷１種）　／　ハンドパーツ一式　／　ディスプレイ用台座

en: Please feel free to join me there.
Gab! te
From "Mobile Suit Gundam: Witch of Mercury ", the main character " Thretta Mercury" in her regular uniform is now available in the Figure-rise Standard series!
Includes new tampo-printed expression parts, various expression decals, hand parts, and more!
● Three-dimensional in general uniform!
Three-dimensional in the general uniform color at Astikasia College of Technology!
The color coding of the uniform is reproduced by dividing the parts. The mark on the chest is decorated with the included Seal.
The hair parts are reproduced in a three-dimensional shape, taking into account the part composition.
The wrinkles on the surface of the boots and the hand parts are detailed down to the delicate fingertips!
● A total of 5 types of rich facial expression parts are included!
A new tampo printing expression is included!
In addition, a total of 4 types of expression reproduction parts including new models are included, and together with water transfer decals, Thretta's rich variety of expressions can be reproduced.
Each facial expression part can also be used for the separately sold "Figure-rise Standard Thretta Mercury" (general over-the-counter sales item)!
● Abundant accessories!
Also included is a halo that allows you to recreate the opening and closing of the ear parts, and a display pedestal that supports Sletta's poses.
The tomato that appeared in the movie and the special right hand part are included with new modeling!
Accessories: Haro / Tomato x 1 / Face parts x 5 types (inner tampo printing 1 type) / Hand parts set / Display pedestal
／ Seal ／ Water transfer decal
Non-Scale Assembly type plastic model
Target age: 15 years old and above
Product material: PS/ABS
・No adhesive is used for assembly
